topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I can't stop looking at it, this little box. It sits there on my desk, taunting me with its weight, its memory. The note's barely a whisper, but the words feel like they're echoing in here with me. "To the teacher who believed, when I didn’t." Every second feels like I'm drowning in the quiet of this room, and all I want is to call you up, to hear your voice and just... understand. Why now? Why this? It’s not the gift, it’s everything it carries. I wish you were here, in this moment, to make sense of it all. I need you, friend. I need your words to breathe again.
